cross_references.note: Barker expands Greenman's design defect prong. Greenman is the foundational strict liability rule; Barker provides the specific design defect test.
Barker design defect against vaccine manufacturers is PREEMPTED by VICP under Bruesewitz v. Wyeth (2011). Barker applies to Walgreens only for non-vaccine devices (syringes).
SIRVA negligent administration (Walgreens) is CA_Medical_Malpractice_Litigator's standard. Barker design defect is a concurrent theory against device/hardware manufacturers only.
RedJag vehicle design defect (Barker) runs concurrently with VEH §11713 dealer fraud. Different theories, different defendants.
